name: Don’t Bite Me
source:
Step into the city of Ridgefall as NoeBody, an apparently ordinary human living a normal life. Until one day, everything that was once part of his routine changes completely.

When a new rehabilitation program ends up excluding a large part of the city's population, he will have to find a way to adapt or be left behind in the process, risking the loss of the only thing that truly matters to him. 

Inspired by I Wani Hug That Gator and Snoot Game.

[From [url=https://midnightmuffinn.itch.io/dont-bite-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
化身为看似平凡普通、过着寻常日子的人类诺伊·博迪，踏入里奇福尔城吧——直到某一天，他习以为常的一切日常彻底发生了改变。

当一项全新的社会改造计划将城中大批居民排挤在外时，他必须设法适应巨变，否则便只能在时代洪流中惨遭淘汰，甚至面临痛失生命中唯一珍视之物的风险。

灵感源自《I Wani Hug That Gator!》与《Snoot Game》。

[摘自[url=https://midnightmuffinn.itch.io/dont-bite-me]itch.io[/url]]
